overall_assessment: Norwegian-language NLA plans (about 13 of 16) are extracted very well: the headings are regular, arbeidskrav stay out of assessment, and Kunnskap/Ferdigheter/Generell kompetanse stay inside learning_outcomes. The real defects are in the English-language plans (3GJ*), where several headings are unmapped so teaching_methods is missing and the introduction and final-assessment text is dropped, plus a recurring stray 'Ingen' placeholder appended to teaching_methods and prerequisites. The pre-pass flags (leak->reading_list, short) are all false alarms.

findings.evidence: `Introduction` → unmapped · `Learning outcomes descriptors` → learning_outcomes · `Content` → course_content · `Teaching and learning methods` → unmapped · `Scope` → unmapped
findings.description: In the English-language NLA plans the headings 'Teaching and learning methods', 'Introduction', 'Final assessment' and 'Syllabus' are unmapped, so their text is dropped. No teaching_methods row exists for 3GJ322 although the plan has a full 'Teaching and learning methods' paragraph; course_content for 3GJ322 is only the cross-reference 'See Organization and teaching methods'; the Introduction text is not in course_content; the 'Final assessment' text is missing so assessment starts at the grading remark; and the 'Syllabus' reading list is not extracted for 3GJ322. Four of 16 courses are English (2 in this packet), so this hits every English NLA plan.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/section_heading_map.R has Norwegian patterns for Innledning, Arbeids- og undervisningsformer, Avsluttende vurdering and Pensum, and only some English ones (Content, Coursework requirements, Grading, Digital reading list). The English equivalents are missing.
findings.suggested_fix: Add patterns in R/section_heading_map.R: ^introduction$ -> course_content, ^teaching (and|&) learning methods$ -> teaching_methods, ^final assessment$ -> assessment, ^syllabus$ -> reading_list, ^practice$ -> teaching_methods (or .drop, in line with the Norwegian Praksis decision). Keep 'Assessment language' and 'Scope' unmapped or map them to assessment and drop respectively, as with Eksamensspråk and Arbeidsomfang.

Ingen.
findings.description: The empty 'Praksis' block (just 'Ingen.') is appended as a line to the real teaching_methods text. The same happens in prerequisites for 4EX101 (Progresjonskrav = 'Ingen': 'Det kreves generell studiekompetanse ... innføringsstudiet. Ingen'). The placeholder is not content (empty_placeholder).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Praksis' is mapped to teaching_methods and 'Progresjonskrav' to prerequisites, and .clean_sections() does not remove blocks that consist only of 'Ingen(.)'.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() in R/extract_sections.R, drop lines that match ^(ingen|ingen\.|-|nei)$ (case-insensitive) when they are the whole text of a block, or when they are a trailing paragraph of a section that otherwise has text.

findings.evidence: Se plan for praksisstudiet i grunnskolelærerutdanningen for trinn 1-7.
findings.description: The one-line cross-reference under the 'Praksis' heading is appended to teaching_methods. It is a pointer to another document, not a description of teaching methods. When 'Praksis' has real content (as in 4HLPL or GL17NO2 'Se egen praksisplan') it may be a legitimate teaching-method; the pure 'Se ...' pointer is not.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Praksis' heading is mapped to teaching_methods unconditionally in R/section_heading_map.R.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections(), drop paragraphs that consist only of a reference ('^(se|sjå|see)\b.*(praksis|plan)') and keep 'Praksis' text otherwise.

findings.description: Block boundaries inside the HTML were concatenated without a separator, so a sub-heading and its paragraph run together ('developmentThis'; also 'SpråkutviklingMuntlig og skriftlig', 'BarnelitteraturBarnelitterære sjangre' in GL17NO2). Words are glued and harder to tokenize.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Inline-element text (strong/em/a) is joined without whitespace by the block reader in R/blocks.R or the text extraction in R/extract_fulltext.R.
findings.suggested_fix: Insert a space or newline when joining adjacent inline or block nodes in the reader (R/blocks.R), or add a regex after extraction that splits a lowercase-to-uppercase transition inside a word (low priority; only if the raw text shows the same gluing).

findings.evidence: View the admission requirements for the MA programme in Global Journalism.
findings.description: The prerequisites section holds only a generic pointer to programme admission requirements, which is not a prerequisite (rubric: admission text is boilerplate). The Norwegian equivalents ('Generell studiekompetanse.') are already removed, so the English pointer slips through.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The admission-boilerplate filter in prerequisites cleaning has only Norwegian patterns.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an English pattern such as '^view the admission requirements' (and 'admission requirements for') to the prerequisites boilerplate filter in .clean_sections().
